baseline_rule: Admissions for the second Saturday in November, from the latest archived target-data update on or before November 19 at 23:59:59 UTC.
target_rule: First reported week at or above four times the frozen early-November reference, using later observed data to locate this illustrative comparison week.
forecast_rule: One archived FluSight-ensemble submission per season, reference date two weeks before the comparison week; no forecast-fit-based example selection.
scope: Illustration of forecasts on the rising limb. The threshold is not estimated from the vaccine model and is not a validated vaccination cutoff.
display_window_note: The displayed window ends at the comparison week to show only the rise; no peak is displayed or used for scaling or alignment.
